research_question: Under a matched Ant-v5 and PPO implementation, does one prospectively frozen Stage-1 task-oriented reward package improve directed and stable flat-ground locomotion diagnostics relative to the default Ant-v5 reward?
estimand: The paired final-policy difference between the shaped and default-reward conditions across independently trained policies generated by the three declared training seeds, conditional on this implementation, budget and evaluation protocol.
claim_boundary: The three-training-seed design is descriptive and conditional on flat-ground Ant-v5. It cannot establish biological natural gait, algorithm-family generality, equivalence, rare-failure rates, hardware transfer or a population-level causal effect beyond the frozen package comparison.

environment.observation_note: The previous applied 8-D action is appended in both conditions so that the action-rate shaped treatment remains Markov and the numerical comparison changes reward only. This matched comparator therefore retains the default Ant reward but is not the unmodified 105-D Gymnasium observation interface.

training.training_seed_unit: one independently initialised and trained policy
training.seed_role: fresh relative to the locally indexed development configurations and result artefacts before launch

evaluation.evaluation_episode_role: nested measurement, not an independent training replicate

conditions.reward_definition: Gymnasium Ant-v5 forward reward + healthy reward + contact reward - 0.5 * squared action; all project shaping weights are zero

The exact reward-v1-foot-landing package from the 17 August development lineage: bounded 1 m/s tracking, lateral velocity, cosine torso orientation, action-rate, root vertical/angular dynamics and four-foot landing-velocity terms; pitch-balance is excluded because it worsened selected diagnostics in development.

decision_rule.status: resource-limited descriptive gate, not a significance test
decision_rule.safety_gate: The shaped condition must not have a higher policy-level unhealthy-termination rate in at least two of the three paired training seeds.
decision_rule.quality_gate: At least three of four quality metrics (target-speed error, direction error, path efficiency and action roughness) must improve in the shaped condition in at least two of the three paired training seeds.
decision_rule.joint_support: Both the safety and quality gates must pass. All raw paired effects remain reportable if the gate fails.
decision_rule.exact_two_sided_sign_test_note: With n=3, even three same-direction pairs have a minimum exact two-sided sign-test p-value of 0.25; no conventional significance claim is possible.

exclusion_and_failure_rules.non_finite_metric: retain as missing/non-finite and report; never coerce to zero
exclusion_and_failure_rules.technical_rerun: allowed only for a documented infrastructure failure before a valid policy result, using the same rule for both conditions
exclusion_and_failure_rules.stopping_rule: complete exactly six policies; do not add seeds, change coefficients or select checkpoints after outcomes are inspected
